subject: Re: LegacyBank — on-prem / air-gapped deployment follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Follow-up & next steps — on-prem / air-gapped qualification

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can validate fit for an air-gapped on-prem deployment: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary requirement: fully air-gapped LLM inference in your on-prem data center (no outbound connections).
- Expected peak concurrency: ~40 simultaneous sessions, ~3k tokens/min aggregate.
- Data governance: customer-managed KMS/HSM, audit logs for all model interactions, 7-year retention for audit events.
- Hardware constraints: currently running on a 3-rack GPU cluster (A1008-like) but hardware refresh planned over next 6-12 months.

Open qualification items / asks from us:
1) Hardware inventory + network topology (can you share a short hardware sheet and whether the cluster supports NVLink between nodes?)
2) Offlined installation window — do you have maintenance windows to allow a physical media install and initial setup?
3) KMS/HSM details and whether your HSM vendor requires any specific connector.
4) SOC2 / penetration-test evidence we should collect to satisfy your internal reviewers.

Proposed next steps:
- If you can share the hw inventory, we’ll run a quick compatibility matrix and come back with a recommended resource profile + quantization options.
- I’m attaching our private-deploy checklist and a short hardware template to fill out (legacybank_airgap_hw_req.xlsx).
- Can we block 60 minutes next Tue (31 Mar) for an infra deep-dive with your on-prem ops folks?

Attachments: redwood_priv_deploy_checklist.pdf, legacybank_airgap_hw_req.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side before we schedule the infra session:

1) Hardware: the cluster is heterogeneous today — mix of older V100 boxes and a few newer nodes. We do not have NVLink across racks, only within rack. A hardware refresh is planned but not funded until Q4. I’ll attach a preliminary inventory.

2) Install windows: we can provide a maintenance window but it must be coordinated with our change control team — typically 11pm-3am local time on Sundays.

3) KMS/HSM: We use a Thales Luna HSM. If Redwood requires HSM integration, we need details on the connector and whether any credentials ever leave the HSM boundary.

4) SOC2 / security evidence: attaching our internal questionnaire — the security team will want to see SOC2 report and details around offline upgrade procedures and rollback capability.

I’ll have our infra lead (cc'd IT alias) join the deep-dive if we schedule.

Regards,
Tom
Senior PM, AI Platforms | LegacyBank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps — on-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification

Hi Tom,

Appreciate the detail — that helps. Short responses inline: 

1) Heterogeneous cluster / NVLink: we can support mixed GPU fleets. NVLink across racks is *not* a hard requirement for Redwood, but it affects latency/throughput characteristics and how we recommend sharding KV caches. We’ll model both the conservative (no cross-rack NVLink) and optimistic (post-refresh) profiles.

2) Install window: Sunday 11pm-3am works; we will treat the initial deployment as an offline install (we bring install media and can run everything without outbound access). Our private agent supports fully air-gapped installation and operations.

3) HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed HSMs (we’ve integrated with Thales in prior deployments). For air-gapped installs we run a connector that never exports private keys; only short-lived signing requests are proxied through the HSM appliance inside the customer boundary. We will prepare a short HSM integration doc for your security team.

4) SOC2 / upgrade rollback: we will share our SOC2 report and a runbook for offline upgrades + rollback. The runbook includes checksum verification, signed packages, and a fallback path to previous model artifacts.

Next steps / ask list (action owners):
- Tom: share the HW inventory spreadsheet and change control contact (you indicated IT alias already).
- LegacyBank IT: provide a preferred Sunday window for initial install (we can be flexible across two weekends).
- Marissa / Redwood: we’ll send a tailored compatibility matrix within 48 business hours and a short HSM integration brief.

I’m attaching the compatibility template filled with the fields we need; Nikhil and Michael will take point on the compatibility mapping.

Can we lock the infra deep-dive for Mon, 29 Mar at 16:00 UTC / 12:00 EDT? If that doesn’t work we can move to Tue, 31 Mar as discussed.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: legacybank_airgap_hw_req.xlsx (updated), redwood_priv_deploy_checklist.pdf
